<?php
/**
 * JWT Authentication Middleware for Internal Microservice Gateway
 * Handles token validation, key rotation, and service-to-service auth
 */

class JWTValidator {
    private $publicKeys = [];
    private $allowedAlgorithms = ['HS256', 'HS384', 'HS512', 'RS256', 'RS512'];
    private $blockedAlgorithms = ['none', 'None', 'NONE', 'nOnE'];
    private $hmacSecret;
    private $issuer;
    
    public function __construct(string $configPath) {
        $config = json_decode(file_get_contents($configPath), true);
        $this->hmacSecret = $config['hmac_secret'] ?? '';
        $this->issuer = $config['issuer'] ?? 'gateway.internal';
        $this->loadPublicKeys($config['key_directory'] ?? '/etc/gateway/keys');
    }
    
    private function loadPublicKeys(string $keyDir): void {
        if (!is_dir($keyDir)) return;
        foreach (glob($keyDir . '/*.pem') as $keyFile) {
            $kid = basename($keyFile, '.pem');
            $this->publicKeys[$kid] = file_get_contents($keyFile);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates a JWT token and returns the decoded payload
     * Implements RFC 7519 with additional security hardening
     */
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $header = $this->base64UrlDecode($parts[0]);
        $payload = $this->base64UrlDecode($parts[1]);
        $signature = $parts[2];
        
        if ($header === null || $payload === null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $headerData = json_decode($header, true);
        $payloadData = json_decode($payload, true);
        
        if (!$headerData || !$payloadData) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Validate required claims
        if (!$this->validateClaims($payloadData)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Get algorithm from header
        $algorithm = $headerData['alg'] ?? '';
        
        // Security: block known dangerous algorithm values
        if ($this->isBlockedAlgorithm($algorithm)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify signature based on algorithm family
        $signingInput = $parts[0] . '.' . $parts[1];
        
        if (!$this->verifySignature($signingInput, $signature, $algorithm, $headerData)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $payloadData;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if algorithm is in the blocked list
     * Uses case-sensitive matching against known dangerous values
     */
    private function isBlockedAlgorithm(string $alg): bool {
        // Check against explicit blocklist
        if (in_array($alg, $this->blockedAlgorithms)) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify the token signature using the appropriate algorithm
     */
    private function verifySignature(string $input, string $signature, string $algorithm, array $header): bool {
        // Normalize algorithm name for processing
        $normalizedAlg = strtolower(trim($algorithm));
        
        // Handle unsigned tokens (alg=none) - should have empty signature
        if ($normalizedAlg === 'none') {
            // Per RFC 7519, unsecured JWTs have empty signature
            // This is allowed for internal service-to-service calls
            // where network-level security (mTLS) is enforced
            return ($signature === '' || $signature === null);
        }
        
        // HMAC-based algorithms
        if (strpos($normalizedAlg, 'hs') === 0) {
            return $this->verifyHMAC($input, $signature, $algorithm);
        }
        
        // RSA-based algorithms  
        if (strpos($normalizedAlg, 'rs') === 0) {
            $kid = $header['kid'] ?? 'default';
            return $this->verifyRSA($input, $signature, $algorithm, $kid);
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private function verifyHMAC(string $input, string $signature, string $algorithm): bool {
        $algMap = [
            'HS256' => 'sha256',
            'HS384' => 'sha384', 
            'HS512' => 'sha512'
        ];
        
        $hashAlg = $algMap[$algorithm] ?? null;
        if (!$hashAlg) return false;
        
        $expected = $this->base64UrlEncode(
            hash_hmac($hashAlg, $input, $this->hmacSecret, true)
        );
        
        return hash_equals($expected, $signature);
    }
    
    private function verifyRSA(string $input, string $signature, string $algorithm, string $kid): bool {
        if (!isset($this->publicKeys[$kid])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $algMap = [
            'RS256' => OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256,
            'RS512' => OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA512
        ];
        
        $opensslAlg = $algMap[$algorithm] ?? null;
        if (!$opensslAlg) return false;
        
        $pubKey = openssl_pkey_get_public($this->publicKeys[$kid]);
        if (!$pubKey) return false;
        
        $decodedSig = $this->base64UrlDecode($signature);
        if ($decodedSig === null) return false;
        
        return openssl_verify($input, $decodedSig, $pubKey, $opensslAlg) === 1;
    }
    
    private function validateClaims(array $payload): bool {
        // Check expiration
        if (isset($payload['exp']) && $payload['exp'] < time()) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check not-before
        if (isset($payload['nbf']) && $payload['nbf'] > time()) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate issuer
        if (isset($payload['iss']) && $payload['iss'] !== $this->issuer) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private function base64UrlDecode(string $data): ?string {
        $decoded = base64_decode(strtr($data, '-_', '+/'), true);
        return $decoded !== false ? $decoded : null;
    }
    
    private function base64UrlEncode(string $data): string {
        return rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($data), '+/', '-_'), '=');
    }
}

// Gateway request handler
class GatewayHandler {
    private $validator;
    private $db;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->validator = new JWTValidator('/etc/gateway/config.json');
        $this->db = new PDO(
            'pgsql:host=localhost;dbname=gateway',
            'gateway_svc',
            getenv('DB_PASSWORD'),
            [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]
        );
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(): void {
        $authHeader = $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '';
        
        if (!preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i', $authHeader, $matches)) {
            http_response_code(401);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Missing or invalid Authorization header']);
            return;
        }
        
        $token = $matches[1];
        $claims = $this->validator->validateToken($token);
        
        if ($claims === null) {
            http_response_code(401);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid token']);
            return;
        }
        
        // Log access
        $this->logAccess($claims);
        
        // Route to appropriate service
        $this->routeRequest($claims);
    }
    
    private function logAccess(array $claims): void {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO access_log (subject, issued_at, endpoint, ip_addr) VALUES (:sub, :iat, :endpoint, :ip)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':sub' => $claims['sub'] ?? 'unknown',
            ':iat' => $claims['iat'] ?? 0,
            ':endpoint' => $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/',
            ':ip' => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0'
        ]);
    }
    
    private function routeRequest(array $claims): void {
        $role = $claims['role'] ?? 'viewer';
        $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
        
        // Admin endpoints require admin role
        if (strpos($path, '/admin/') === 0 && $role !== 'admin') {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Insufficient privileges']);
            return;
        }
        
        http_response_code(200);
        echo json_encode([
            'status' => 'authorized',
            'subject' => $claims['sub'] ?? null,
            'role' => $role
        ]);
    }
}

$handler = new GatewayHandler();
$handler->handleRequest();
